definitions.explanation: to be conspicuous; to be prominent; to be particularly noticeable among others

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美|うつく}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{際立|きわだ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{際立|きわだ}って⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The red color is strikingly visible.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{際立|きわだ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: His talent stands out among his colleagues.

notes:
{際立|きわだ}つ is an intransitive godan verb meaning "to stand out" or "to be conspicuous." It describes something being noticeably different or prominent compared to its surroundings.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The transitive counterpart is {際立|きわだ}たせる (to make something stand out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {際立|きわだ}って⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (strikingly beautiful)
- {際立|きわだ}った⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧ (distinctive feature)
- {際立|きわだ}った⟦{存在感|そんざいかん}→存在感：19948_sonzaikan⟧ (striking presence)
- {際立|きわだ}った⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧ (notable difference)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Often used with て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ to describe a current state: {際立|きわだ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (stands out)
- The past participle {際立|きわだ}った is commonly used as an adjective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: More common, general "to stand out"
- {際立|きわだ}つ: More literary, emphasizes contrast with surroundings

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly literary.
